contract.task_clause:
The false analogy fallacy is
Option A: a specific type of false cause fallacy that argues that since two event happened at the same time one event must have caused the other
Option B: arguing that an event that preceded another event necessarily is the cause of the second event
Option C: arguing that since something is new it is necessarily good
Option D: drawing a conclusion based on a comparison when the items being compared are not similar enough to support the conclusion.
